Several words in the final paragraph are doubtful (the reference after "methodi" and the Greek-letter marks rendered as "&" and "Mt." are uncertain). Line 'noストrae' is a misreading: the printed word is "nostrae"; the reference "p.118" and "Mt.i." are doubtful. The paragraph beginning "Verba mea" carries a heading-like "VI." which is a paragraph number and should be read as a paragraph opener.
